object.attr: analysis: review Q42, Answered on 2026-11-11, to confirm. git mergetool's .orig files and editors' swap files in a document folder are uncommitted changes that a commit takes unseen. MELLON-STORE-SRS-50 makes them validation errors once built.
object.description: When a commit holds a file in a document folder whose name the on-disk format doesn't define, Mellon should name the file in the commit's result.
